mohEnabled.description: Music on hold is enabled or disabled for the workspace.

greeting.description:
Greeting type for the workspace.
 * `DEFAULT` - Play music configured at location level.
 * `CUSTOM` - Play custom music when call is placed on hold or parked. An audio file must already have been successfully uploaded to specify this option.

audioAnnouncementFile.description: Announcement Audio File details when greeting is selected to be `CUSTOM`.
